spanish: para separar entre lo impuro y entre lo puro, y entre la bestia viva la comida y entre la bestia viva que no será comida.

findings.issue: The articular niphal passive participle (the one that is eaten) is rendered as the noun phrase la comida (the food/meal), so the passive sense of being eaten is omitted.

notes: The parallel que no será comida keeps niphal imperfect 3fs; the first eating token does not.
